Classgrid — Educational Management Platform Operated by: Classgrid Technologies, Pune, Maharashtra, India Registered Address: Akurdi Railway Station Road, Sector No. 26, Pradhikaran, Nigdi, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Maharashtra 411044, India

These Terms of Service ("Terms", "Agreement") govern Your access to and use of the Classgrid website (classgrid.in), its sub-domain tenant websites (*.classgrid.in), the Classgrid mobile application ("App"), and the Classgrid ERP Platform (collectively, the "Platform"), operated by Classgrid Technologies ("Company", "We", "Us", "Our").

By accessing or using the Platform, You agree to be bound by these Terms. If You do not agree to these Terms, please do not access or use the Platform.

If You are accepting these Terms on behalf of a Tenant Organization (school, junior college, or coaching institute), You represent and warrant that You have the authority to bind the organization to these Terms.

children.text: "User" / "You" / "Your"
— Any individual who accesses or uses the Platform in any capacity.
"Student"
— An individual enrolled in a Tenant Organization who uses the Platform.
"Parent/Guardian"
— A parent or legal guardian of a Student.
"Faculty"
— A teacher, professor, or educational staff member at a Tenant Organization.
"Org Admin"
— An authorized representative of a Tenant Organization who manages the institution's account.
"Tenant Organization"
— An educational institution (school, junior college, coaching institute) that subscribes to the Platform.
"Tenant Website"
— A website hosted on a sub-domain of classgrid.in (e.g., collegename.classgrid.in) managed by a Tenant Organization.
"Services"
— All features, tools, and functionalities provided through the Platform including the ERP system, CMS, mobile application, and tenant websites.
"Content"
— Any text, images, videos, documents, data, or other materials uploaded, shared, or displayed on the Platform.
"Subscription"
— A paid or free plan that grants a Tenant Organization access to specific Platform features.
2.1 Age Requirements
You must be at least 18 years old to create an account as an Org Admin or Faculty member.

Students under 18 years of age may use the Platform through accounts created by their Tenant Organization, with parental/guardian consent obtained by the institution as part of the enrollment process.
Parents/Guardians may create accounts to monitor their ward's academic progress.
2.2 Institutional Requirements
Tenant Organizations must be legally registered educational institutions or coaching centers operating in compliance with applicable Indian education laws and regulations.
The Org Admin must be a person authorized by the institution to enter into this Agreement on its behalf.
2.3 Geographic Availability
The Platform is currently available for educational institutions operating in India.
The Company reserves the right to expand or restrict geographic availability at any time.
3.1 Account Creation
Institutional accounts (Tenant Organizations) are created upon submission of an application through the Platform and subsequent approval by the Company, or through the Company's sales team.

Individual User accounts are created by one of the following methods: (a) the Tenant Organization's Org Admin creates and invites accounts directly from the admin dashboard; (b) Faculty members receive invitation links generated by the Platform containing a secure, time-limited activation token; (c) Students self-register through the Platform using a valid email address and the Organization Honor Code provided by their institution; or (d) accounts are provisioned automatically through the Admissions module upon successful admission.
The Platform supports multiple authentication providers for account creation and sign-in, including manual email and password registration, Google, Facebook, GitHub, and LinkedIn OAuth.
You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information during registration.
3.2 Account Security
You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of Your account credentials, including email, password, and session tokens.
The Platform enforces an automated account lockout policy. After five consecutive failed login attempts, the account is temporarily locked for a period of five minutes to prevent brute-force attacks.

The Platform maintains a trusted device registry. Each device from which You log in is identified by a cryptographic fingerprint (a SHA-256 hash of the user agent and network address). When a login attempt is detected from an unrecognized device, a login notification email is sent to the registered email address. The trusted device registry is limited to ten devices per account; the oldest device is removed when this limit is exceeded.
You agree to immediately notify Us at support@classgrid.in if You become aware of any unauthorized use of Your account.
We are not liable for any loss or damage arising from Your failure to maintain the security of Your account credentials.
We recommend using strong, unique passwords and enabling all available security features provided by the Platform.
3.3 One Account Per User
Each individual should have only one User account within a Tenant Organization.
Sharing of account credentials between individuals is strictly prohibited.
The Company reserves the right to suspend or terminate duplicate or shared accounts.
3.4 Account Types and Roles

The Platform enforces role-based access control (RBAC). Each User is assigned a primary role that determines the dashboard view and access permissions. The Platform also supports an additional roles system, allowing a single User to hold multiple roles simultaneously (for example, a Head of Department who also teaches may hold the roles of HOD and Faculty concurrently).
The following primary roles exist:

cells: Full administrative control of the Tenant Organization, including user management, billing, classrooms, and configuration
Classroom management, attendance, grading, assignments, and student interactions
Org Admin, Admissions Module, or self-registration via Honor Code
Classroom participation, assignments, notes, grades, and attendance records
Department-level oversight, faculty supervision, and academic coordination
Institution-level administrative access and oversight of all departments
Examination scheduling, grading policies, and result management
Fee structure configuration, invoice generation, and payment tracking
Admissions pipeline management, application review, and enrollment decisions
Document verification and applicant credential review
Applicant guidance, inquiry handling, and follow-up management
Administrative data entry and applicant record maintenance
Training and placement operations, company liaison, and student career services
Vehicle fleet, route planning, and student transport logistics
Library catalog management, issue/return tracking, and inventory
Student well-being, academic advising, and pastoral support
Cross-functional coordination, event management, and workflow facilitation

children.text: 4.1 ERP and Institutional Management
The Platform provides the following core services (availability depends on subscription plan):
Attendance Management
— Digital attendance tracking with QR code and manual entry support
Academic Management
— Grade entry, report card generation, assignment distribution and submission tracking
Fee Management
— Fee structure definition, payment tracking, receipt generation, and installment management
Timetable Management
— Class scheduling, faculty allocation, and timetable display
Communication
— Institutional notices, circulars, announcements, and messaging between stakeholders
Student Information System
— Comprehensive student records including enrollment, academic history, and personal details
Faculty Management
— Faculty profiles, attendance, and teaching load management
Library Management
— Book catalogue, issue/return tracking
Transport Management
— Route management, bus tracking
Canteen Management
— Menu management, order tracking
Examination Management
— Exam scheduling, hall ticket generation, result processing
4.2 Tenant Website (CMS)
Tenant Organizations receive a hosted website on a sub-domain (e.g., collegename.classgrid.in)

The CMS allows management of: Hero section, programs, notices, faculty gallery, events, blog, testimonials, alumni, fees, merit lists, mandatory disclosures, committees, infrastructure, downloads, and more
The tenant website design follows the Classgrid design system with customizable primary colors and branding
4.3 Mobile Application
The Classgrid mobile app (Android and iOS) provides on-the-go access to Platform features including attendance, notices, academic data, communication, and more
Feature availability in the mobile app may differ from the web platform
4.4 AI-Powered Features
The Platform may include AI-powered features such as past paper analysis, academic insights, and automated recommendations
AI features are advisory in nature and should not replace professional academic judgment
The Company reserves the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue AI features at any time
5.1 Plans
The Platform offers the following subscription tiers:

cells: Basic ERP, limited features, basic tenant website
Full ERP, all modules, advanced tenant website, priority support
As per current pricing on classgrid.in

children.text: The Company reserves the right to modify pricing, features, and plans at any time with 30 days prior notice to existing subscribers.
5.2 Billing and Payment
Subscription fees are billed on a monthly or annual basis as selected during subscription
Payments are processed securely through
Razorpay
. The Company does not store Your card or banking details
All prices are listed in Indian Rupees (INR) and are exclusive of applicable taxes (GST at 18%)
Invoices are generated automatically and available in the Org Admin dashboard
5.3 Late Payment and Suspension
If payment is not received within 15 days of the due date, the Company reserves the right to:
Send payment reminders via email
Restrict access to premium features
Suspend the Tenant Organization's account after 30 days of non-payment
Take the tenant website offline after 45 days of non-payment
Suspended accounts can be reactivated upon full payment of outstanding dues
5.4 Refund Policy
Annual subscriptions: Eligible for a pro-rated refund if cancellation is requested within 30 days of subscription start
Monthly subscriptions: No refund for the current billing period; cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing cycle
Free plan users: No charges, no refund applicable
Refund requests must be submitted to billing@classgrid.in with Your organization name, subscription ID, and reason for cancellation
Approved refunds will be processed within 14 business days via the original payment method
5.5 Free Plan Terms
The FREE plan is provided at the discretion of the Company and may be modified or discontinued at any time
Free plan users do not receive guaranteed uptime, priority support, or advanced features
The Company reserves the right to place reasonable usage limits on free plan accounts
6.1 Org Admin Responsibilities
As the institutional administrator, You are responsible for:
Ensuring all institutional data entered on the Platform is accurate and up-to-date
Obtaining appropriate parental/guardian consent before entering minor students' data
Managing user accounts (creation, deactivation, role assignment) for Your institution
Ensuring that faculty and staff use the Platform in compliance with these Terms
Managing content published on Your tenant website, ensuring it is accurate, lawful, and does not infringe third-party rights
Maintaining the confidentiality of admin credentials
Complying with all applicable educational regulations, board requirements, and data protection laws
6.2 Faculty Responsibilities
Using the Platform only for legitimate educational purposes
Maintaining the accuracy of attendance records, grades, and academic data entered
Not sharing login credentials with other faculty members or students
Following the institution's data handling policies when accessing student information
6.3 Student Responsibilities
Using the Platform for legitimate academic purposes only
Not sharing account credentials with other students
Submitting only original academic work (not plagiarized content) through the Platform
Treating communication through the Platform with respect and professionalism
6.4 Parent/Guardian Responsibilities
Using the Platform only to monitor their ward's academic progress and communicate with the institution
Not attempting to access other students' data or accounts
Reporting any concerns about their child's data to the Org Admin or Our support team
7.1 You May NOT Use the Platform To:
Violate any applicable local, state, national, or international law or regulation
Upload, post, or transmit any content that is unlawful, defamatory, obscene, offensive, threatening, abusive, harassing, or otherwise objectionable
Impersonate any person or entity, or falsely state or misrepresent Your affiliation with any person or entity
Upload viruses, malware, or any other malicious code
Attempt to gain unauthorized access to any part of the Platform, other User accounts, or any computer systems or networks connected to the Platform
Interfere with or disrupt the Platform's servers, networks, or infrastructure
Scrape, crawl, or use automated tools to extract data from the Platform without express written permission
Reverse engineer, decompile, disassemble, or otherwise attempt to derive the source code of the Platform
Use the Platform for any commercial purpose other than its intended educational use
Send unsolicited communications (spam) through the Platform
Collect or harvest personal information of other Users without their consent
Use the Platform to discriminate against any individual or group based on caste, religion, gender, disability, or any other protected characteristic
Upload or publish content that infringes intellectual property rights of any third party
7.2 Content Standards
All content published on the Platform (including tenant websites, notices, blog posts, and gallery) must:
Be accurate and not misleading
Comply with applicable laws including the Information Technology Act, 2000
Not contain hate speech, discriminatory content, or content promoting violence
Not infringe any third-party intellectual property rights
Not contain personal information of individuals without their consent
Be appropriate for an educational context
7.3 Enforcement
The Company reserves the right to:
Remove any content that violates these Terms without prior notice
Suspend or terminate accounts that violate the Acceptable Use Policy
Report illegal activities to law enforcement authorities
Cooperate with law enforcement investigations
8.1 Sub-Domain Hosting
Each Tenant Organization is assigned a sub-domain (e.g., collegename.classgrid.in)
The sub-domain remains the property of the Company and is licensed to the Tenant Organization for the duration of the subscription
Custom domain mapping (e.g., www.collegename.edu.in → collegename.classgrid.in) may be available on PRO plans
8.2 Content Responsibility
The Tenant Organization is solely responsible for all content published on its tenant website
The Company does not moderate, edit, or review tenant website content prior to publication
The Company reserves the right to remove or disable access to content that violates these Terms, applicable law, or third-party rights
8.3 Website Takedown
The Company may take a tenant website offline if:
The subscription has expired or payment is overdue (as per Section 5.3)
The content published violates these Terms or applicable law
A valid legal takedown notice is received
The Tenant Organization requests deactivation
8.4 SEO and Indexing
Tenant websites may be indexed by search engines
The Company provides basic SEO setup but does not guarantee search engine rankings
The Tenant Organization is responsible for the accuracy of meta tags, descriptions, and other SEO elements managed through the CMS
9.1 Company's Intellectual Property

The Platform, its underlying technology, software code, design, user interface, logos, trademarks ("Classgrid"), documentation, and all related intellectual property are the exclusive property of Classgrid Technologies
The "Powered by Classgrid" branding on tenant websites is mandatory and may not be removed or hidden
You are granted a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable license to use the Platform for its intended purpose during the term of Your subscription
9.2 Restrictions
You may not:
Copy, modify, distribute, or create derivative works of the Platform's software or design
Remove, alter, or obscure any proprietary notices, labels, or marks on the Platform
Sub-license, sell, rent, lease, or transfer any rights to the Platform to any third party
Use the Classgrid name, logo, or trademarks without prior written consent
9.3 Feedback

If You provide suggestions, ideas, feedback, or recommendations regarding the Platform, You grant the Company a worldwide, perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to use, modify, and incorporate such feedback into the Platform without any obligation to You.
10.1 Ownership
You retain ownership of all content You upload, submit, or publish on the Platform (including institutional data, student records, website content, images, and documents)
By uploading content to the Platform, You grant the Company a limited license to host, store, display, and transmit such content solely for the purpose of providing the Platform Services
10.2 Content License
For tenant website content that is set to "public," You grant the Company a license to display and distribute such content on the tenant website for public access
The Company will not use Your content for advertising, marketing, or any purpose beyond operating the Platform, unless You provide explicit consent
10.3 Content Removal
You may remove Your content at any time through the Platform's admin tools
Upon account or subscription termination, Your content will be handled as described in the Data Retention section of Our Privacy Policy
The Company reserves the right to remove content that violates these Terms
11.1 Institutional Data Ownership
All institutional data (student records, academic data, faculty information, notices, content) entered by a Tenant Organization into the Platform remains the property of the Tenant Organization
The Company acts as a Data Processor and does not claim ownership of institutional data
11.2 Data Portability
Tenant Organizations may request a full export of their institutional data at any time
Data exports are provided in standard machine-readable formats (CSV, PDF, JSON)
Data export requests should be made through the Org Admin dashboard or by emailing support@classgrid.in
Data exports will be fulfilled within 30 days of the request
11.3 Data After Termination
Upon subscription termination, institutional data is retained for 1 year as described in Our Privacy Policy
After the retention period, all data is permanently and irreversibly deleted
The Company will provide at least 3 export reminders during the retention period
Your privacy is important to Us. Our collection, use, storage, and sharing of Your personal information is governed by Our
Privacy Policy
, which is incorporated into these Terms by reference.
By using the Platform, You acknowledge that You have read and understood Our Privacy Policy.

17.1 Termination by You
FREE plan users may discontinue use of the Platform at any time by requesting account deletion
PRO plan subscribers may cancel their subscription as per the refund policy in Section 5.4
To request account or data deletion, contact support@classgrid.in
17.2 Termination by the Company
The Company may suspend or terminate Your account immediately, without prior notice, if:
You breach any provision of these Terms
Your payment is overdue for more than 30 days (PRO plan)
We are required to do so by law or a court order

We decide to discontinue the Platform (with at least 90 days prior notice)
17.3 Effect of Termination
Upon termination:
Your right to access the Platform ceases immediately
Tenant websites are taken offline
Institutional data is retained for 1 year for export, then permanently deleted
Provisions that by their nature should survive termination (including indemnification, limitation of liability, intellectual property, and dispute resolution) shall survive
18.1 Informal Resolution
Before filing any formal claim, You agree to attempt to resolve the dispute informally by contacting Us at support@classgrid.in. We will attempt to resolve the dispute within 30 days.
18.2 Mediation

If the dispute is not resolved informally, both parties agree to attempt mediation before proceeding to arbitration or litigation. Mediation shall be conducted by a mutually agreed mediator in Pune, Maharashtra.

summary: Updated Section 3 (Account Registration and Security): Expanded the role-based access control (RBAC) table from 4 to 17 roles reflecting the full platform capability, including HOD, Principal, Fee Manager, Admission Head, TPO Officer, and more. Clarified account creation methods to include OAuth sign-in (Google, Facebook, GitHub, LinkedIn), self-registration via Honor Code, and Admissions module provisioning. Added details on the automated account lockout policy, trusted device fingerprinting, and login notification emails for unrecognized devices.
